_comment: Settings for run_s3_vlm.py. Relative paths resolve against instance_vlm_run/. Prompts (final_prompts), prices, checks and the model's max_output_tokens come from vlm_run/configs/config.json. Command-line options override these values.
_layout_note: Every object under source ending in head_suffix is one episode: <task>/<episode>/<name>_head.mp4. Head view only.
_resolution_note: Gemini media_resolution low: about 280 tokens per image. long_side_px / jpeg_quality: size of the JPEG sent (null = the v2 config's frames values, 768 px / 80).
_thinking_note: Gemini generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel: minimal, low, medium, high (null = model default, which used ~10.5k thinking tokens for a 590-token answer on task01/episode_000004). Checked against the live API on 2026-11-24: 'medium' accepted, invalid values rejected with HTTP 400. Added when the batch file is written, so changing it needs no re-sampling; recorded in job.json and every vlm_result.json.
_max_output_note: Output cap per episode (answer + thinking). 65,536 is Gemini 3.8 Flash's outputTokenLimit (models API, 2026-11-24). Only generated tokens are billed, so a higher cap costs nothing unless used. Largest seen so far: 23,057 (task06/26, 3 fps, default thinking). Set when the batch file is written (no re-sampling).
_retry_note: Episodes that end without a parsed answer (finish reason MAX_TOKENS, unparseable or missing) are sent once more in a small second batch with thinking_level retry_thinking_level; the result records the thinking level actually used.
_batch_note: All episodes go into ONE Gemini Batch API job (half price) as an uploaded JSONL file (Files API, up to 2 GB), so long episodes (e.g. task04 episode_000000: ~460 images at 3 fps, ~38 MB) fit. A second job is created only if the JSONL would exceed max_batch_mb. Batch jobs finish in minutes to 24 h; an interrupted wait is picked up with --resume.
_workers_note: Episodes downloaded and decoded in parallel processes while preparing the requests.
_results_note: Everything of one episode in one folder: <results_dir>/<task>/<episode>/ (<name>_vlm_result.json, step_table.json, frames/ and raw_response.json with debug). Plus <results_dir>/summary.csv and <results_dir>/batches/<id>/job.json.
_upload_note: Each parsed <name>_vlm_result.json is also written (same file name) into the S3 folder of its MP4: <task>/<episode>/<name>_head.mp4 -> <task>/<episode>/<name>_vlm_result.json. Episodes without a parsed response are not uploaded. --no-upload keeps everything local.
